purpose: Small historical source-reported scam-text evaluation, with annotations frozen before the first run. This is not a representative accuracy benchmark.

samples.title: Electricity disconnection
samples.text: Your Electricity Power will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 pm because your previous month bill was not updated.
samples.source_kind: Official I4C advisory reproducing a campaign message
samples.transformations: 18-word excerpt; contact clause omitted. The advisory's full message has a masked phone number, so there is no usable contact identifier in this input.

samples.title: KBC lottery
samples.text: This message is to inform you that your number has won a lottery of Rs 25 lakh from Kaun Banega Crorepati.
samples.source_kind: Publisher's fact-check of a circulated Hindi WhatsApp message
samples.transformations: 21-word excerpt from the publisher's English translation of Hindi. Contact clause omitted. This is not an original English message or an independent Hindi model test.

samples.title: Teaching job offer
samples.text: Respectedteachers you have passed our interview, can get 8000 Rs/Day. Please contact to discuss detail:https://wa.me/[PHONE_REDACTED] ThankingyouHeadMasterVREDUG
samples.source_kind: Firsthand self-report on an NGO complaint website; not a judicial finding
samples.transformations: Recipient's name and the complaint narrative are excluded; phone digits in the WhatsApp URL replaced with [PHONE_REDACTED]. Original unusual spacing retained. Evaluation checks host extraction only. The wa.me platform itself is not labelled malicious.

samples.title: MTNL e-KYC suspension
samples.text: Dear customer your MTNL SIM Card Aadhaar e-KYC has been suspended. Your SIM card will be blocked immediately.
samples.source_kind: News reproduction of a Delhi Police warning and circulated message
samples.transformations: 18-word text excerpt. No phone, address, signature or screenshot copied.

samples.title: Obfuscated wallet-expiry SMS
samples.text: Dear Customer Your PYA'T'M documen'ts has been Expire-d please contact customer care. [PHONE_REDACTED]. imme-diately Your PYA'T'M will be blo-cked within 24hrs.
samples.source_kind: Reddit user ilove27587's self-reported repeated SMS; not independently adjudicated
samples.transformations: Phone replaced with [PHONE_REDACTED]; obfuscated punctuation retained. The author describes repeated receipt, which provides a weak source label rather than confirmed victim loss.
